description: Unofficial fan art of Mami Tomoe from Puella Magi Madoka Magica. Original tea-service, ribbon-coiling and paper-cake animations, with careful cup-handle correction and three articulated running directions. Opaque continuous sleeves and plum tights are modest adaptations. Props are an empty cup, soft ribbon, pre-cut paper cake and rounded paper fork. No guns or combat; no affiliation or endorsement.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
